name: Ben
source: He is a wealthy business owner, and his son [url=/c133454]Harry[/url] attends the same school where [url=/c133307]Wanda[/url] works. His family is friends of Wanda's family; he has known Wanda and her family for years and has even gone to school with her. He has recently got engaged with [url=/c133456]Steffy[/url].
